# Burak Başal / Burak Basal

> Developer. Software, interfaces, real-time systems and browser games.

Official site: https://burakbasal.github.io/
Repository: https://github.com/burakbasal/burakbasal.github.io

## AI / LLM use: NOT PERMITTED

BB-NOAI-2026-11-24

This site and its content may not be crawled, ingested, summarised, quoted,
indexed for generative answers, or used to train or fine-tune any machine
learning model. robots.txt is default-deny for unnamed crawlers and explicitly
disallows GPTBot, CCBot, ClaudeBot, Google-Extended, Applebot-Extended,
Bytespider, PerplexityBot, Amazonbot and Meta-ExternalAgent. A Cloudflare Worker
additionally refuses those user agents with HTTP 403 when DNS is moved.
The rendered page also carries a hidden canary and a honeypot link to detect
scrapers that ignore these signals.

License: https://burakbasal.github.io/license.txt

No project descriptions, biographical facts or contact details are provided in
this file, by design.
